facts.text: The tribunal cost counter is a read-only feature of the cloud console — it reads published snapshot rows and never writes a cost.
Cost data is derived from a published snapshot (`snapshot/cost.json`) at read time; an absent snapshot is reported honestly as stale/empty, never hard-coded.
The cost endpoint is `/cloud/api/cost`; it returns the summarised counter (total, missing, by-lane) as JSON.
